p: of the people for many isles: Which serves all the world with your merchandise.
Senir: This mountain was called Hermon but the Amorites called it Shenir, De 3:9.
Chittim: Which is taken for Greece and Italy.
calkers: Meaning, that they built the walls of the city, which is here meant by the ship: and of these were the builders of Solomon's temple, 1Ki 5:18.
Gammadims were in thy towers: That is they of Cappadocia, or pygmies and dwarfs which were called because from the high towers they seemed little.
Javan: Of Greece, Italy and Cappadocia.
in the persons of men and: By selling slaves.
Togarmah traded in thy fairs with: Which are taken for a people of Asia minor.
horns of ivory and ebony: Meaning, unicorn's horns and elephant's teeth.
Minnith: Where the best wheat grew.
east wind hath broken thee in: That is, Nebuchadnezzar.
common lands shall shake at the: That is, the cities near you, as Zidon, Arund and others.
any more: By which is meant a long time: for it was prophesied to be destroyed but seventy years, Isa 23:15.
